headers.description: Newline-separated Name:Value lines. A value of exactly %ASSETS/<asset-name>% is replaced by that Orchestrator asset's value, from the server's folder, each time the header is sent.

connectionId.description: Integration Service connection whose token authenticates the calls. Use an OAuth connection of the UiPath MCP connector (uipath-uipath-mcp), the one Agent Gateway offers: the service stores any connection Integration Service finds, and one it gets no OAuth token from fails every call.
